content.value_statement: Document extraction projects need reliable SDK patterns for Azure AI Document Intelligence. This skill provides concise .NET examples for authentication, prebuilt models, custom models, classifiers, and error handling.
actual_capabilities: Shows .NET package installation for Azure.AI.DocumentIntelligence and Azure.Identity.
Demonstrates Entra ID and API key authentication patterns.
Provides examples for invoices, receipts, layouts, document classification, and model management.
Explains custom model and classifier build workflows with blob container sources.
Lists key SDK types, build modes, best practices, and reference links.
limitations: Does not create Azure resources, storage containers, or service credentials.
Requires users to supply their own endpoint, permissions, documents, and SAS URLs.
Examples must be validated against the installed SDK version and project settings.
Does not replace security review for processing sensitive documents.

use_cases.title: Add Document Extraction
use_cases.description: Add invoice, receipt, or layout extraction to a .NET service.

use_cases.title: Prototype Custom Models
use_cases.description: Outline custom model and classifier workflows before building training data pipelines.

use_cases.title: Review SDK Options
use_cases.description: Compare prebuilt models, authentication choices, and related SDK references.

prompt_templates.title: Install the SDK
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to list the .NET packages and environment variables needed for Azure AI Document Intelligence.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Invoice Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a .NET workflow that reads an invoice and reports vendor, total, and line items.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Custom Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a custom model build using a blob container source and a stable model identifier.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Classifier Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design document classification, model management, and error handling for a production .NET service.

output_examples.input: I need to extract invoice totals in a .NET application.
output_examples.output: Use the prebuilt invoice model, create a DocumentIntelligenceClient, analyze the invoice URI, and check field confidence before using totals.

output_examples.input: I need a custom model for fixed forms.
output: Choose template build mode for fixed layouts.
Store labeled training files in an Azure Blob container.
Use a stable model identifier and review field confidence after training.

output_examples.input: I need to classify incoming documents.
output_examples.output: Define classifier document types from training data folders, build the classifier, then classify each document and inspect confidence.

best_practices: Prefer Entra ID with DefaultAzureCredential when production permissions allow it.
Store endpoints, keys, and SAS URLs outside source control.
Check confidence scores before using extracted fields in automated decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys or SAS tokens into prompts or source files.
Do not assume example URLs, model IDs, or SDK versions match your environment.
Do not process sensitive documents without access controls, retention rules, and logging review.

faq.question: Does this skill run Azure commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation and .NET examples. Users must run commands and code in their own environment.

faq.question: Which authentication method does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends Entra ID with DefaultAzureCredential for production and also shows API key authentication.

faq.question: Can it analyze invoices and receipts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for prebuilt invoice and receipt models.

faq.question: Can it help with custom models?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows custom model and classifier workflows, but users need training data and Azure permissions.

faq.question: Does it store documents or credentials?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains examples only and does not store data.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
